meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 OpenClaw 配置迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw configuration to NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are migrating from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2

howto.what: 这个技能帮你把 OpenClaw 机器人的配置迁移到 NanoClaw v2。它会扫描旧安装，找出身份、频道、定时任务等，然后分步问你哪些要搬、放哪，应用前先展示改动。它不会偷偷复制数据。
howto.when: 当你说“migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration”或“import from openclaw”时，技能会接管。

say.text: 帮我把 OpenClaw 的数据搬到 NanoClaw v2。
say.note: Claude 会扫描旧安装并汇报发现。

say.text: 我想从 OpenClaw 迁移过来。
say.note: 它会检查是否找到 OpenClaw 安装。

howto.what_en: Helps you migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Scans old install for identity, channels, cron jobs etc., then interactively decides what to move and where, showing changes before applying. No silent copying.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'migrate from openclaw', 'openclaw migration', or 'import from openclaw'.

say_en.text: I'd like to migrate OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2.
say_en.note: Claude scans and summarizes the old install.

say_en.text: Help me import my OpenClaw data into NanoClaw.
say_en.note: It asks what to bring over.
